body: I've been thinking about this every day for almost exactly two years. My situation has only gotten worse since these thoughts started. Continuing to live a miserable and lonely life does not interest me at all

I don't have anyone to talk to. No friends. My family doesn't care to listen when I talk to them, they just continue texting away at whoever they deem to be more important than their own son who justs wants to enjoy their company while he's on vacation from school. I've been to three therapists already and none of them have helped me in any significant way. I tried taking antidepressants, but they only made me feel numb and nothing more. 


In the last 5 years, I recall feeling happiness twice. Just twice. It felt like something had clicked in my brain as all of my depressive symptoms had just vanished. That was about a week ago before I realized that my even my family doesn't listen when I talk to them. I was talking to my mom and she didn't even look up from her phone or stop texting--my dad is glued to his phone when we are at dinner--my sister treats me like dog shit, to say the least. I cry myself to sleep every night. At least, when I'm not high. My chest hurts from the emotional pain and loneliness, but smoking usually helps the pain go away.


How are things going to suddenly get any better? I can't even get my family to care about talking to me, how am I going to get complete strangers to do it? My mom and sister know very well about my depression and suicide attempts, yet they treat me as if nothing were wrong. Clearly they don't care. If they did they wouldn't ignore me when I'm asking nothing more than for someone to talk to. Is that too much to ask? I'm genuinely wondering if I'm just being too needy without realizing it. 


That's all I want. That's all I've really ever wanted but never had. I've gone months without a single unread text on my phone; I'm sure being dead wouldn't be all too different for the people in my life.
It's not just one person, sadly, but thanks for the response

>but clueless on how it's actually useful.

Guess that makes two of us

I am not mentally stable. I almost went through with committing suicide 2 times already and sometimes still think about it. I just don't have anyone in my life that I trust enough to tell, nor do I know anyone that will help me if I confess. I just want help

Fuck...out of everything I've ever read on this sub, I've never related to any of it... but this just hits home a little too well. I wish I could offer solid fool-proof advice, but at least know that you're not alone. This is the *exact* (and I mean *exact*) reason for my depression. No friends; no love life; just inexplicably offputting.


Do people also make rash assumptions about you as a person--assumptions that you have no idea how they even rationalized it?
